description: Vesting of a block of land for the construction of buildings to provide hostel facilities for students and official quarters for the academic and non‑academic staff of the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - At present, approximately 2,070 students are studying in the Faculty of Medicine and Allied Sciences and the Faculty of Agricultural Sciences of the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka, which was established in 1995, and about 150 academic and non-academic staff are serving attached to the said Faculties. Since those Faculties are located in a rural area adjacent to the Anuradhapura-Medawachchiya main road, on a land with limited space, providing suitable residential facilities while ensuring the safety of the students and staff has become a prime requirement. Accordingly, it has been planned to construct 02 student hostel complexes, 06 family-unit official quarters for academic and non-academic staff, 12 single-unit official quarters and 02 playgrounds for volleyball and netball. A block of state land in extent of 02 acres 9.6 perches located in Thannayamkulama Grama Niladhari Division of the Nuwaragam Palatha Central Divisional Secretariat Division, situated close to the said Faculties, has been identified as suitable for the relevant construction. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to vest the said block of land with the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka through a Free Grant in accordance with the provisions of the State Land Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.
